subject.title: feat(ios): durable offline command outbox for chat sends

question: Is the text-only iOS durable outbox storage and replay contract acceptable for v1 once the FIFO/lint blockers and real proof are fixed, or should this wait for a broader mobile outbox privacy/product design?
rationale: The branch stores private user commands for later Gateway delivery and intentionally narrows the canonical issue to text-only iOS, so maintainer intent is needed for the privacy, retention, replay, and staged-scope boundary.

options.title: Accept text-only v1 after fixes
options.body: Require the mechanical FIFO/lint fixes plus redacted real behavior proof, then allow the bounded text-only iOS outbox to proceed as the staged implementation for the canonical feature.

options.title: Hold for broader contract
options.body: Pause this branch until maintainers approve a cross-platform text/voice outbox contract covering privacy, background sync expectations, queue review, and retention.

options.title: Narrow to internal experiment
options.body: Keep the implementation behind follow-up maintainer work and avoid user-facing docs or release positioning until the security and UX contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept text-only v1 after fixes
recommendation.body: Require the mechanical FIFO/lint fixes plus redacted real behavior proof, then allow the bounded text-only iOS outbox to proceed as the staged implementation for the canonical feature.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the active stacked iOS cache/outbox implementation and has the strongest recent history on the affected shared chat path.
